key.name: display-mode
key.description: Whether to display lyrics as a floating desktop overlay ('floating') or in the GNOME top bar ('panel').

key.name: lyrics-visible
key.description: Master visibility toggle for lyric display.

key.name: fallback-mode
key.description: Display behavior when synced lyrics are unavailable ('track', 'idle', or 'hidden').

key.name: floating-locked
key.description: When enabled, the floating overlay is click-through and cannot be dragged.

key.name: floating-lines
key.description: Number of lyric lines shown in floating mode (1 = current, 2 = current + next, 3 = previous + current + next).

key.name: floating-x-ratio
key.description: Normalized horizontal position (0.0 to 1.0) within the target monitor workarea.

key.name: floating-y-ratio
key.description: Normalized vertical position (0.0 to 1.0) within the target monitor workarea.

key.name: floating-monitor-index
key.description: Target monitor index for the floating overlay (-1 uses the primary monitor).

key.name: floating-max-width
key.description: Width (or maximum width) in pixels for the floating lyric overlay.

key.name: floating-preserve-width
key.description: Keep the floating overlay at a constant width to prevent horizontal layout shifting between short and long lyric lines.

key.name: floating-show-vinyl
key.description: Display a spinning vinyl record with the current track's album cover on the floating overlay.

key.name: floating-show-track-info
key.description: Display the current song title, artist, and album name in the floating overlay header.

key.name: floating-show-controls
key.description: Display Previous, Play/Pause, and Next controls on the floating overlay.

key.name: floating-show-progress
key.description: Display an interactive playback progress bar and timestamps on the floating overlay.

key.name: floating-font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels for the active lyric line in floating mode.

key.name: floating-bg-opacity
key.description: Background pill opacity percentage (0 = pure transparent subtitle style, 100 = solid dark pill).

key.name: floating-animate
key.description: Enable smooth fade/slide transitions when lyric lines change in floating mode.

key.name: floating-hide-fullscreen
key.description: Automatically hide the floating overlay when a window is fullscreen on its monitor.

key.name: floating-hide-paused
key.description: Automatically hide the floating overlay when media playback is paused.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Where the indicator is placed in the GNOME top bar ('left', 'center', or 'right').

key.name: panel-index
key.description: 0-based order within the selected top-bar panel box (-1 appends to the end).

key.name: panel-max-width
key.description: Maximum width in pixels for the top-bar lyric label.

key.name: text-align
key.description: Horizontal alignment of lyric text ('left', 'center', or 'right').

key.name: style-text-color-type
key.description: Text color preset ('default', 'system', 'white', 'black', or 'custom').

key.name: style-text-color-custom
key.description: Custom HEX color code when text color preset is 'custom'.

key.name: style-secondary-opacity
key.description: Opacity percentage for previous and next context lyric lines in floating mode.

key.name: style-text-shadow
key.description: Enable drop shadow behind lyric text for readability.

key.name: lyrics-offset-ms
key.description: Shift synced lyrics earlier (negative) or later (positive) in milliseconds.

key.name: player-priority
key.description: Preferred MPRIS player bus-name fragments, in priority order.

key.name: browser-player-service
key.description: How browser MPRIS players should be interpreted ('auto', 'spotify', 'youtube-music', 'apple-music', or 'generic').

key.name: cache-enabled
key.description: Whether lyric lookup results should be cached locally.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Whether verbose diagnostic logging should be enabled.

key.name: shortcut-toggle-mode
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to switch between Floating Overlay and Top Bar mode.

key.name: shortcut-toggle-lock
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to toggle click-through lock on the floating overlay.

key.name: shortcut-toggle-visible
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to show or hide lyrics.
